context.body: Amazon no longer preps or labels FBA inventory in Canada. Units have to arrive ready, so the label, the bag and the box are now your job, or ours.
cta.title: Open an account and get our address in two minutes.
est.custom: 5,000 units or more get a custom rate. Start the order and we'll send a quote within one business day.
faq.balance.a: Add funds by card and every order is paid from it in one click. Every charge, refund and top-up shows up in your balance history, so you always see where the money went.
faq.china.a: Yes, that's how most of our customers work. You stay the importer of record and handle customs and duties with your freight forwarder. We receive the cartons here in Hamilton.
faq.china.q: Can my supplier in China ship straight to you?
faq.fbmship.a: You buy the shipping label yourself, through Amazon Buy Shipping, Shopify, Chit Chats, Stallion or Canada Post, and upload it to the order. Our FBM fee covers picking, packing and attaching the label, so you pay postage at your own rates with no markup from us.
faq.fee.a: No monthly fee and no minimum order. Storage is free for the first {days} days after an order is received.
faq.fee.q: Is there a monthly fee or minimum?
faq.pallets.a: Yes, up to {max} standard 48×40 pallets per order, up to 1,000 kg each. For more, message us first so we can make room. Book the freight with liftgate delivery, because we don't have a loading dock. We don't unload full containers; send those to a cross-dock and have pallets delivered from there.
faq.plan.a: You create it in Seller Central (or we can do it with your permission) and upload the box and pallet labels to the order. Connect your Amazon store in the dashboard and we can see your SKUs, FNSKUs and stock.
faq.plan.q: Who creates the Amazon shipment plan?
faq.storage.a: We're a prep center, not a long-term warehouse, so storage is priced to keep stock moving. The first {free} days are free, then {pallet} a pallet or {box} a box per month, doubling after {long} days. Pallets can stay up to {max} days and we hold at most {count} pallets per customer at a time. After {max} days we ship pallets back or to an address you choose, at your cost. FBM stock on our shelves has no time limit.
faq.storage.q: How long can you store my inventory?
faq.tier.a: By the number of units in one inbound order. 1–999 units pay the first rate, 1,000–1,999 the second, 2,000–4,999 the third. From 5,000 units we quote a custom rate.
faq.title: Questions sellers ask us
faq.why.a: Amazon stopped offering its own prep and item labeling service for FBA shipments in Canada on July 1, 2026. Inventory now has to arrive at Amazon already labeled and packed to its rules, or it can be refused or charged for.
faq.why.q: Why do I need a prep center now?

hero.lead: Labeling, poly bags, bundles, cartons and pallets at prices you can see before you sign up. Order in a cart, pay from your balance, and follow every carton from the moment it reaches us to the fulfillment center.
hero.title: Your supplier ships to Hamilton. We ship to Amazon.
how.1.d: Pick Amazon, Walmart or FBM, enter the unit count and tick the services you need. The price updates as you go, HST included. Pay from your balance or by card.
how.1.t: Build the order in your cart
how.2.d: After payment you get our Hamilton address with your customer code and order number on it. Your supplier in China or anywhere else prints that on every carton.
how.2.t: Give our address to your supplier
how.3.d: We count every carton against your order and send you photos. Then we label, bag, bundle or wrap exactly as you asked. Most orders are done in 24–48 hours.
how.4.d: Cartons or pallets go to the Amazon or Walmart fulfillment center on your shipment plan. For FBM we keep the stock on our shelves and ship each order as it comes in.
how.title: From your supplier's truck to the fulfillment center in four steps
